About Tonyland

A school built around growth, discipline and learning.

Tonyland Group of Schools is a school in Egbe, Lagos State serving learners across Creche, Nursery, Primary and Secondary levels.

The school presents its learning environment around quality education, co-curricular activities, well-groomed teachers and a conducive environment for learning.

“Excellence Through Hardwork”
